title: Transactional mutation message
summary: Зафиксировать mutation в P5 outbox без values и без зависимости на search.
why: `P10-design.md` §9; D55. Projection должна быть durable и privacy-minimal.

include:
internal domain event; explicit translator; v1 message contract;
registry extension; outbox append в store transaction; replay/rollback tests.
exclude: search consumer; ordering promise; raw values in payload; webhook.

rules:
Append in same tenant DB transaction after mutation and before
commit. Replay appends nothing. Payload whitelist only; sorted ids/keys. Extend resolved
registry additively. No `CoreX\\Search` import.
guidance:
Domain event is internal; translator is the only mapping to public
message type. Consumer uses record version to converge, not delivery order.

validation.procedure: one committed mutation creates one outbox row; replay creates none on both engines
outbox rejection rolls back values, record and write token on both engines
metadata-only sorted payload and additive registry with collision refusal
attributes package has zero CoreX Search dependency
attributes static analysis and P10.7 scoped style
